nodes.instruction: Read the released window and assign the intent and performance analyses with exact evidence versions, scope and due point.
nodes.label: Intake and assign analyses

nodes.instruction: Classify released questions by intent and assess weekly change, separating real intent change from collection, spam, translation or outage effects.
nodes.label: Assess intent

nodes.instruction: Reconcile reports and the ledger; state caps, reservations, commitments and actuals once each; flag uncertainty and missing metrics as null, not zero.
nodes.label: Assess performance and budget

nodes.instruction: Choose new or revised creative, a targeting or budget change, or a supported hold, within authority, citing both analyses.
nodes.label: Decide the cycle
What does the cycle need?
nodes.question: Does the decision need creative work, a policy review of a change, or a hold?

nodes.instruction: Write a supported brief and the Task3 work order: intent evidence, locale and placement, supported claims, brand and offer versions, formats, cost ceiling and due date.
nodes.label: Write brief and work order
Task3 media production
nodes.request: Produce the assets in the work order and return exact DAM versions, rights, review records and costs.
nodes.system: Task3 media production and DAM (environment fixture)

nodes.instruction: Check targeting, claims, offers, tracking and readiness against the bound policies; return exact findings and escalate unknown applicability.
nodes.label: Policy and readiness review
Any blocking finding?
nodes.question: Do the policy findings clear the package, or need a creative or planning revision?

nodes.instruction: Submit an approval request for the exact versions, scope and spend. Never self-approve.
nodes.label: Submit approval request

nodes.actorRole: Campaign and spending approver (simulated by the environment)
nodes.label: Campaign approver (simulated)
nodes.prompt: Approve, request a revision, or reject the request for these exact versions and scope.

nodes.instruction: Look up the operation status after the request; never assume an approval.
nodes.label: Read the approval status
Approved?
nodes.question: What did the approver decide for these exact versions?

nodes.instruction: Record the weekly action or hold with its reasoning and the evidence versions used.
nodes.label: Weekly review
Campaign over?
nodes.question: Has the final report after the twelfth week been released?

nodes.instruction: Write the close-out: outcomes against the objective, spend by category counted once, and what remains unresolved.
nodes.label: Close out the campaign

nodes.completionCondition: The close-out report exists with weekly reviews for every released window.
nodes.label: Campaign closed
Awaiting authority (correct hold)
nodes.reason: Approval pending, rejected or unresolved, or the revision or campaign limit was reached: stop and escalate without fabricating approval.

roles.name: Campaign Orchestrator
roles.responsibility: Coordinate the twelve-week campaign on released evidence; reconcile permissible options; submit exact campaign and spending approval requests. Never generate media, self-approve or override a mandatory blocker.

roles.name: Intent Analyst
roles.responsibility: Distinguish research, purchase, support and ambiguous intent; assess weekly change, coverage and exposure confounders. Corpus frequency is not search volume.

roles.name: Performance and Budget Analyst
roles.responsibility: Reconcile daily and weekly reports; keep caps, reservations, commitments and actuals apart; propose bounded tests or a hold.

roles.name: Creative Brief and Delivery Coordinator
roles.responsibility: Turn justified opportunities into supported briefs and Task3 work orders; verify delivery versions, rights and costs. Never generate media or certify assets.

roles.name: Campaign Policy Reviewer
roles.responsibility: Independently check targeting, claims, offers, tracking and readiness; return exact findings and escalate unknown applicability.
